entities.name: Drownyard
entities.description: Seagraf reef near Nephalia on Innistrad where many ships were lost and Nahiri built a ring of cryptoliths; focal point of redirected leylines.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Crazed Lithomancer who constructed the cryptolith ring.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: Necromancer whose ghouls built the temple.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Researcher whose findings suggested an eldritch moon.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi drawn to the plane through the planar portal by Nahiri, kept from fully manifesting until Avacyn was killed.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel protector of Innistrad whose death left it unprotected.

events.summary: Nahiri builds a ring of cryptoliths at the Drownyard using Gisa's ghouls.
events.quote: She made use of Gisa 's ghouls to build this so-called Drownyard temple

events.summary: Tamiyo's findings link the temple to an unseen massive object in the sky, an eldritch moon.
events.quote: The findings of Tamiyo supported a connection between the temple and an invisible object

events.summary: Emrakul, drawn through the portal by Nahiri, is kept from fully manifesting until Avacyn is killed.
events.quote: kept from fully manifesting until Avacyn was killed and Innistrad was thus left unprotected

relations.note: She built the cryptolith ring there.
relations.quote: the crazed Lithomancer Nahiri constructed a ring of cryptoliths
Emrakul who had been drawn to the plane through the planar portal by Nahiri
